amount (IDR) -> package_size.

Two ladders were in force inside this window, and the menu card for 29 Sep - 4 Oct 2025 is the evidence for both. Rack rate: 1x 40.000, 2x 39.000, 5x 33.000, 10x 28.000, 20x 26.000, 40x 24.000, 80x 23.000. From 8 Sep to 25 Sep an opening discount - a one-time launch promo, never repeated - took 3.000 off every rung: 37.000, 36.000, 30.000, 25.000, 23.000, 21.000, 20.000.

Nine of those fourteen rungs were already in this file, derived independently from the December orders and from memos that state a size outright ('catering 40x', 'Pembayaran Catering 5x', 'kuota 10'). That agreement is the reason to trust the rest. The four added afterwards are 150.000, 165.000, 460.000 and 520.000. Because the discount was a launch promo and not a tier, no amount dated after 25 Sep 2025 may be priced off the discounted ladder. The printed end was 24 Sep and it ran one day long: Jeslyn Verdita's Rp 72.000 on 25 Sep is 2 x 36.000, a discounted rung, and Justin confirms the extra day.

40.000 is deliberately NOT mapped. The rack ladder makes it one portion, but 20.000 is already one portion on a legacy rate, so 40.000 is equally two of those and nothing in the amount decides. An ambiguous rung is worse than a missing one: a missing rung reports itself, a wrong one does not.

Everything here divides exactly and lands between Rp 19.000 and Rp 40.000 per portion.
